headline: Egypt Introduces First-Come Investment Land Allocation Requiring US Dollars
summary: Egypt's Ministry of Housing introduced a first-come, first-served allocation system for investment land, allowing eligible companies to secure plots through full payment in US dollars transferred from abroad.
why: Mechanisms requiring foreign currency for state land allocations are designed to attract direct foreign investment and boost national foreign exchange reserves.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: The policy encourages foreign currency inflows via land purchases.
